description.value: Monashee Lodge is a motel in Revelstoke, BC, a town that sits at the confluence of the Columbia and Illecillewaet Rivers and serves as a major hub for cyclists on the Trans-Canada corridor and BC interior touring routes. Revelstoke is surrounded by spectacular mountain terrain and the motel's location on 3rd Street West places it within reach of the town core and its services.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website URL resolves to entirely unrelated Hebrew-language gardening content, indicating the domain has likely been captured by a content farm after lapsing; no motel-specific information can be extracted from it. All amenity fields default to null because the website provides zero corroborating evidence and OSM amenity tags alone are insufficient per the rules. OSM does confirm the motel category, address, and phone, and the looks_closed flag is false, suggesting the physical property likely still operates even though the domain is gone.
